images.prompt:
Original whimsical cosy autumn storybook colouring-book line art in crisp black ink on clean white paper. Use bold rounded outer contours, medium interior lines, smooth lightly hand-drawn organic shapes, medium scene detail, generous closed areas for colouring, and shallow layered depth created only through overlap and sparse contour accents. Render characters, where present, with friendly simplified cartoon proportions and tiny expressive features. No colour, grey, shading, hatching, texture, gradients or solid black fills; maintain a warm, gentle, playful printable feel.

SHARED STYLE (style only): illustration style: Whimsical cosy autumn storybook colouring-book line art, translated into an original bold-and-easy printable format.; line weight: Bold, clean black outer contours with medium-weight interior details; consistently generous open areas for colouring.; line quality: Smooth rounded digital linework with a lightly hand-drawn organic character; closed, unbroken shapes and crisp edges.; detail level: Medium detail: each page has a clearly readable main vignette with a restrained layer of seasonal decorative details, avoiding tiny marks and dense textures.; character language: Friendly simplified cartoon proportions, with rounded silhouettes, expressive dot-and-curve faces, uncomplicated limbs and clear readable gestures.; background density: Moderately detailed scene backgrounds built in shallow layers, with controlled negative space and broad colourable areas.; palette: Monochrome black line art only; designed to suit any autumnal colouring palette chosen by the customer.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No tonal fills, gradients, hatching or solid black shadows; depth is conveyed through overlaps, contour lines and sparse interior accents.; texture: Clean white-paper finish with no simulated grain, speckling or distressed effects, ensuring clear home-print results.; mood: Warm, gentle, playful and quietly nostalgic, with a relaxed seasonal feel.; print considerations: High-contrast black line art on white backgrounds, suitable for A4 and US Letter home printing. Keep all essential artwork comfortably inside safe margins, use closed colouring shapes, and avoid hairline details, large ink-heavy fills and edge-to-edge elements..

REFERENCE CHARACTERISTICS (general only, never copied): palette: Cozy, earthy, saturated-but-muted fall palette with cream highlights and deep dark accents. The Halloween reference shifts to a navy, brown and orange palette while retaining warm candlelit highlights. Overall palette is harmonious and seasonal rather than neon-bright.; linework: Prominent dark brown-to-black outer contours, approximately 3–6 px at the shown cover scale; inner details use thinner but still clearly legible dark outlines. Lines are mostly uniform, with occasional slightly thicker silhouette edges; no delicate engraving or hatching-heavy linework.; texture: Noticeable lightly grainy paper/paint texture across coloured fills, plus tiny flecks, stipple-like highlights and occasional mottled tonal variation. This texture enriches cover art but is not required for clean black-and-white colouring interiors.; composition density: High but organized density. A central hero scene is surrounded by themed supporting objects, with foreground props overlapping the main setting. Cover typography occupies a strong dedicated upper zone, while plants, pumpkins, leaves or small icons fill gaps without leaving large empty areas.; background: Fully illustrated, scene-based backgrounds. Reference 1 uses a detailed indoor conservatory with windows; reference 2 uses a cottage café exterior; reference 3 uses a dark night-sky backdrop within a wooden stage-like frame. Backgrounds include layered environmental details but remain subordinate to the central focal scene.; mood: Warm, nostalgic, gentle and inviting; cozy domestic autumn comfort with a lightly playful, non-threatening spooky mood in the Halloween example..

source_concept.tagline: Gentle garden scenes for family colouring
source_concept.target_customer: Families and children ages 6+ who enjoy gentle nature-themed colouring
source_concept.short_description: A 10-page autumn colouring book set in a welcoming garden. Pages feature a hedgehog by a compost bin, robin at a bird feeder, squirrel gathering acorns, snail on a cabbage leaf, frog beside a pond, mouse in a shed, sleeping cat among flowerpots, apple tree harvest, seed-saving table and a leafy garden gate.
key_features: Bold, closed shapes for easy colouring
Black-and-white A4 and US Letter printable pages
No text required within the illustrations
source_concept.visual_direction_summary: A gentle wildlife-focused route with close-up garden discoveries, broad colourable foliage and familiar autumn garden routines.

visual_route.palette_emphasis: Open leaf, soil, flowerpot and fruit colouring areas
visual_route.distinguishing_visual_hook: Tiny wildlife discoveries among garden tasks

source_concept.preview_brief: A hedgehog pauses beside a seed packet basket in a leafy autumn garden, with a watering can, pumpkins and broad falling leaves around it. The portrait cover uses a clear central vignette and an open sky area for optional title placement.

source_concept.tagline: A storybook train trip through autumn
source_concept.target_customer: Families and children ages 6+ who enjoy transport and storybook colouring
source_concept.short_description: A 10-page autumn railway colouring book following a charming countryside train trip. Pages include ticket booth arrival, luggage trolley, platform farewell, train crossing a viaduct, dining carriage, woodland tunnel, signal box, lakeside stop, apple-orchard station and an evening journey home.
key_features: 10 connected but independently colourable railway scenes
Landscape compositions with clear train silhouettes
Friendly traveller characters and countryside details
Generous colouring areas with simple layered scenery
Black-and-white A4 and US Letter printable pages

visual_route.palette_emphasis: Open train panels, hills, trees and travel luggage
visual_route.distinguishing_visual_hook: Storybook train winding through falling leaves

source_concept.preview_brief: A small vintage steam train curves across a countryside viaduct while friendly travellers wave from the windows and leaves drift over rolling hills. The landscape cover gives the train a strong sweeping focal line with broad, colourable scenery.
